2609.02253.title: APEx: Distillation of Agent Procedural Experience for Adaptive Deep Research Question Answering
2609.02253.paper_summary: Deep research agents augment large language models with external tools to answer complex, long-horizon questions through multi-turn reasoning. Learning from prior experience is crucial for continual improvement, yet existing methods either retrieve verbose task-specific traces that burden decision-making, or distill procedural skills that remain decoupled from downstream policy adaptation. We propose APEx, a hierarchical experience utilization framework that organizes interaction history into instance-level trajectory memories and category-level procedural skills, and couples them through a closed-loop architecture of Executor, Distiller, and Planner. The three modules are optimized via a three-stage alternating GRPO training paradigm, enabling reward-guided skill distillation rather than fixed-prompt generation. At test time, distilled skills serve as procedural priors for online Planner adaptation through skill-guided test-time reinforcement learning, allowing ground-truth-free self-improvement with skill-alignment regularization to prevent policy drift. Experiments on 7 benchmarks demonstrate that APEx achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing GPT-5.4 by 14.7 points and the strongest memory-augmented baseline by 3.0 points.
2609.02253.paper_summary_zh: 深度研究代理透過外部工具增強大型語言模型，以便通過多輪推理回答複雜的長期問題。從先前的經驗中學習對於持續改進至關重要，然而現有的方法要麼檢索冗長的任務特定痕跡，這會增加決策負擔，要麼提煉出與下游政策適應脫節的程序技能。我們提出了APEx，一個層次化的經驗利用框架，將互動歷史組織為實例級的軌跡記憶和類別級的程序技能，並通過執行者、提煉者和規劃者的閉環架構將它們結合起來。這三個模塊通過三階段交替的GRPO訓練範式進行優化，實現了基於獎勵的技能提煉，而不是固定提示生成。在測試時，提煉出的技能作為在線規劃者適應的程序先驗，通過技能引導的測試時間強化學習，實現無需真實標籤的自我改進，並通過技能對齊正則化來防止政策漂移。在7個基準上的實驗表明，APEx達到了最先進的性能，超越了GPT-5.4 14.7分，並且比最強的記憶增強基線高出3.0分。
